热演化切比雪夫多项式的端点行为与稀疏傅里叶剪切流的局部通量: Heat-evolved Chebyshev edges and localized fluxes of sparse Fourier shears
本文研究热演化下高阶切比雪夫多项式的端点增长，区分整体振幅与邻近位置对比的两个对: This manuscript studies endpoint growth of high-degree Chebyshev polynomials under heat evolution. It separates the logarithmic scales of the overall amplitude and the contrast between nearby positions, gives uniform error bounds, and verifies the result for normalized second-kind polynomials. A sequence of exact Fourier shears, each with its own fixed initial datum, then connects these estimates to signed local flux over an entire time interval and shows how the conclusions depend on the observation frame and velocity normalization.
投影 Lamb 场的热堆积与三维 Navier–Stokes 流的尖锐迹障碍: Projected-Lamb Heat Packing and Sharp Trace Obstructions for Three-Dimensional Navier–Stokes Flow
在零均值周期设定下，本文证明投影 Lamb 场的归一化热扩展体积量受 Leray: In the zero-mean periodic setting, this manuscript controls the normalized heat-extension bulk of the projected Lamb field using the Leray energy inequality. Exact smooth solutions exhibit a sharp trace loss. A positive-time internal shell-entry construction further shows that a specific normalized \(\dot H^{-1}\)-Lamb time integral cannot control the entry atoms with a uniform constant along the constructed scaling family. The remaining zero-level occupation estimate is unresolved.
